hero.title: Become a Partner
hero.lede: Have a network of clients or a company in immigration, legal, financial or real estate services? Partner with Sharif Group and offer your clients second citizenship and residency, backed by our team in Dubai.

items.d: Offer more programmes to your clients.
Law, accounting, wealth management, real estate and travel.
Introduce people looking for a second passport or residency.
We get to know you and complete our standard checks.

form.title: Partnership application
form.sub: Leave your details and our team will contact you.
form.name: Full name
form.message: Tell us briefly about your network or business
form.consent: I agree that Sharif Group may contact me about this application.
form.privacy: Your details are used only to review your application and contact you.
form.note: Partnership terms are shared after review, in a written agreement.
form.errPhone: Please enter a valid WhatsApp number.
form.errEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
form.errConsent: Please confirm that we may contact you.

thanks.title: Thank you, {name}!
thanks.text: We have received your application. Our partnerships team will contact you on WhatsApp or by email.
thanks.already: We already have an application with this email address. Our team will be in touch.
